title: An outfall held under water
process: a sewer whose outlet stands above the street: water comes back up the inlet until the street stands at the outlet level
executor: node (CPU surface solver) and browser (GPU); raw measurements in street/raw/, scored by run.mjs
equations: no rain: at rest the street water stands at the outlet level; volume from the sag's storage curve
with rain: the SS3 pond equation with H_out = the held level
boundaryConditions: surface closed on all sides. The outlet is held 0.15 m above the sag. SS4-a, -c, -d: a FIXED outfall in the .inp. SS4-b: the app's own way, an outfall into a stream with the level given to the coupler (Coupler.stage).

cases.unit: times s; levels m relative to the sag

solver: FloodSim surface solver with the app's settings (hdry 1e-5 m, hfront 1e-3 m, dtDry 2 s; MUSCL minmod, HLLC, SSP-RK2, CFL 0.48). cpu rows: src/solver-cpu.js (fp64). gpu rows: src/solver-gpu.js in Chrome WebGPU (fp32). Coupled cases: the production Coupler (src/coupler.js, exchange every 2 s) and EPA SWMM 5.2.4 (vendor/swmm-wasm) with the .inp the app writes (src/drainage.js toINP: dynamic wave, SLOT surcharge, variable step 0.75 up to 1 s, MIN_SURFAREA 1.2 m^2, inertial damping PARTIAL). SS4-c uses spill at the rim; the others two-way exchange (the app default).

reference.sources: still water stands level; the SS3 references
reference.independence: the level is the boundary condition itself; the volume is the terrain's storage below it

outputs: no rain: street level and street volume at 3600 s
with rain: pond level at 3600 s and 7200 s
reported: the same street with a free outfall (PV-SS3 case c)
criteriaNotes: As PV-SS3. The no-rain level is a still-water level, so 5 mm.
assumptions: the held level does not change during the run
validRange: an outlet level above the street at a sag inlet
scoring: automated: street/score.mjs builds rows with lib/score.mjs row(); one row set per executor (cpu, gpu), never merged; a case with no raw file is listed as not run and has no rows

criteriaRevisions.why: first registration, before any sandbox case was run
